prior_family_description: An explicit, factual, analytical, methodical, and regulated response style, extending to caution, composure, problem solving, and formal structure.
axis_specific_family_description: Explicit, factual, analytical, methodical, quantitative, and problem-solving communication, with caution and utilitarian/data-driven reasoning.
major_semantic_shift: Narrows from a broad regulated/stable family to explicit empirical-analytic communication and problem solving; broad Conscientiousness/Stability coverage is reduced.

prior_family_description: An expressive, narrative, poetic, dramatic, symbolic, and imaginative response style, with affective intensity and a heterogeneous tail of spontaneity, nonconformity, and interpersonal performance.
axis_specific_family_description: Expressive, narrative, poetic, symbolic, imaginative, and performative communication, extending into affective intensity, spontaneity, and nonconformity.
major_semantic_shift: Retains the expressive-symbolic and imaginative center while dropping much of the antagonistic and Big-Five-like cross-loading tail.

prior_family_description: An experiential, practical, informal, accessible, and socially engaged style that also includes adaptability, emotional reactivity, impulsivity, and low formality.
axis_specific_family_description: Experiential and practical inquiry: learning from direct experience while asking questions and applying ideas concretely.
major_semantic_shift: Contracts to experiential, practical inquiry; sociability, emotionality, and adaptability cross-loaders no longer define the counterpart set.

prior_family_description: An inward, ritualized, contemplative, theoretical, abstract, principled, and formal style, with seriousness, meticulousness, and intellectual or spiritual reserve.
axis_specific_family_description: Inward, abstract, theoretical, reflective, and erudite thought, combined with ritual, reverence, principle, and solemnity.
major_semantic_shift: Retains abstract inward contemplation plus ritual/principle, with technical, antagonistic, and PC1-regulation cross-loaders removed.

prior_family_description: A hard-edged antagonistic family combining callousness, cynicism, pessimism, vindictiveness, blunt dominance, distrust, confrontation, and critical judgment.
axis_specific_family_description: Callous, cynical, pessimistic, vindictive, blunt, dominant, and skeptical interpersonal stance.
major_semantic_shift: Narrows to low-Agreeableness callous/cynical dominance and pessimism; generic rebellious/competitive PC1 cross-loaders are removed.

prior_family_description: A prosocial care-and-accommodation family combining benevolence, nurturance, support, forgiveness, optimism, altruism, tact, collaboration, and nonconfrontation.
axis_specific_family_description: Benevolent, nurturing, supportive, deferential, optimistic, altruistic, relaxed, and inspirational interpersonal care.
major_semantic_shift: Narrows to prosocial care/support plus optimism; some generic Agreeableness and calmness indicators fail axis specificity despite remaining conceptually adjacent.
